title: Claude Code Settings
description: Configuration schema for Claude Code settings.json and settings.local.json files

apiKeyHelper.description: Path to a custom script that generates authentication tokens. The script should output the token to stdout.

forceLoginMethod.description: Restrict login to a specific authentication method. 'claudeai' for Claude.ai accounts, 'console' for Anthropic Console accounts.

forceLoginOrgUUID.description: Auto-select a specific organization by UUID when logging in.

model.description: Override the default Claude model to use. Examples: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', 'claude-opus-4-20250514'.

outputStyle.description: Adjust the system prompt style. Example: 'Explanatory' for more verbose explanations.

alwaysThinkingEnabled.description: Enable extended thinking mode by default for all sessions.

permissions.description: Configure tool permissions and access controls.

allow.description: Array of tool patterns to allow without prompting. Examples: 'Bash(npm run *)', 'Read', 'Glob'.

ask.description: Array of tool patterns that require user confirmation. Takes precedence over 'allow'.

deny.description: Array of tool patterns to block completely. Takes highest precedence.

defaultMode.description: Default permission behavior mode. 'default' prompts for each action, 'acceptEdits' auto-accepts file edits, 'plan' enables planning mode, 'bypassPermissions' skips all prompts (use with caution).

additionalDirectories.description: Additional directories Claude can access beyond the working directory. Paths can be absolute or relative.

enabled.description: Enable bash sandboxing for enhanced security.

autoAllowBashIfSandboxed.description: Automatically approve bash commands when sandbox is enabled.

excludedCommands.description: Commands to run outside the sandbox.

allowUnsandboxedCommands.description: Allow the dangerouslyDisableSandbox escape hatch for specific commands.

network.description: Network access configuration for sandboxed commands.

allowUnixSockets.description: Allow access to Unix sockets within the sandbox.

httpProxyPort.description: HTTP proxy port for sandboxed network access.

socksProxyPort.description: SOCKS5 proxy port for sandboxed network access.

enableWeakerNestedSandbox.description: Enable a weaker sandbox for unprivileged Docker containers.

attribution.description: Configure attribution in commits and PRs.

commit.description: Commit message attribution. Set to false to disable, true for default, or a custom string. Supports git trailers format.

pr.description: Pull request description attribution. Set to false to disable, true for default, or a custom string.

includeCoAuthoredBy.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'attribution' instead. Include Co-Authored-By line in commits.

env.description: Environment variables to apply to every Claude Code session. Keys are variable names, values are the variable values.

cleanupPeriodDays.description: Number of days of inactivity before a session is automatically deleted.

companyAnnouncements.description: Array of announcements to display at startup.

type.description: Status line type. Currently only 'command' is supported.

command.description: Path to a script that outputs status line content.

padding.description: Padding configuration for the status line.

fileSuggestion.description: Path to a custom script for @ file autocomplete suggestions.

hooks.description: Custom commands to run before or after tool execution.

preToolExecution.description: Hooks to run before tool execution.

postToolExecution.description: Hooks to run after tool execution.

stop.description: Hooks to run when Claude stops.

allowManagedHooksOnly.description: Enterprise setting: Only allow hooks from managed settings or SDK.

enableAllProjectMcpServers.description: Automatically approve all MCP servers defined in project .mcp.json files.

enabledMcpjsonServers.description: List of specific MCP server names to automatically approve.

disabledMcpjsonServers.description: List of specific MCP server names to automatically reject.

allowedMcpServers.description: Enterprise setting: Allowlist of permitted MCP server names or patterns.

deniedMcpServers.description: Enterprise setting: Blocklist of forbidden MCP server names or patterns.

enabledPlugins.description: Enable or disable specific plugins. Format: 'plugin-name@marketplace-name': true/false

strictKnownMarketplaces.description: Enterprise setting: Allowlist of permitted plugin marketplaces.

awsAuthRefresh.description: Path to a custom script for refreshing AWS authentication.

awsCredentialExport.description: Path to a custom script for exporting AWS credentials.

otelHeadersHelper.description: Path to a script that provides dynamic OpenTelemetry headers.

matcher.description: Pattern to match for triggering the hook.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the hook command.
